heading: ## The cardinal rule
reason: Pins the rule in its NEGATIVE form, which is the load-bearing direction: a session idle at the danger line with no declaration is never restarted — the daemon does not infer readiness from idleness, a timer, or how low context has fallen.

heading: ## Out-of-band state declaration
reason: Pins the ONE-file/ONE-value design directly: the ambiguity that two presence markers allowed (both existing at once) is unrepresentable when a single file holds a single first line.

heading: ## The supervision round
reason: Pins round closure and re-opening: clearing the injection stamp — exactly what a restart does — resets both the round timestamp and the notified bands, so a subsequent round starts fresh and every band may fire again.

heading: ## The escalating wrap-up
reason: Pins 'MUST actually escalate rather than repeat': above 30% remaining the message is a suggestion, at 30% and below an insistent demand to stop now.

heading: ## The restart
reason: Pins the hard-gate guarantee that a declaration is never silently destroyed: a failed respawn PRESERVES the ready marker so the next observation retries.

heading: ## The keep-going nudge
reason: Pins the clause that makes the daemon-written marker safe: the daemon removes its own value only while the file still holds it, so it can never clobber a declaration the session wrote in the meantime.

heading: ## The watch-set declaration
reason: Pins the admission rule verbatim: an entry is admitted only when its checkout exists on disk AND contains a plan directory; a failing entry is silently inert rather than an error.

heading: ## Track discovery and the mapping store
reason: Pins the discovery rule's headline: one track per UNARCHIVED plan-topic directory, keyed on the directory existing — archived plans are excluded.

heading: ## Session-name derivation
reason: Pins the derivation exactly: the bare plan topic by default, with a <repo-slug>-<topic> single-dash qualifier added ONLY on a genuine cross-repository collision.

heading: ## Surface-only startup
reason: Pins 'startable, never started': a discovered plan directory with no session comes back with status 'unassigned' and tmux None — surfaced, with no session spawned for it.

heading: ## Supervised runtimes
reason: Pins the one destructive cross-runtime failure the spec designs out — a restart must resume the SAME runtime. SABOTAGE-VERIFIED 2026-07-25: re-pointing _do_codex_restart at the CLAUDE command turned this and two sibling tests red, then was reverted to a zero diff.

heading: ## Non-interference with tracked work
reason: Pins the startup gate that makes the whole non-interference property enforceable: the daemon verifies every watched repository ignores its scratch path and REFUSES to run if any does not, so supervision can never dirty a tracked working tree.

heading: ## Notify, never block
reason: Pins alert self-sufficiency, which is what makes a non-blocking relay usable: because the relay is the operator's only handover, every track-scoped alert names its plan topic, repository, session and pane.

heading: ## Fail-soft posture
reason: Pins the posture's sharpest clause — an unknown context reading NEVER counts as a threshold crossing, so an ambiguous reading can never trigger an act.

heading: ## The state file
reason: Pins the contract's fail-closed rule: a value outside the table ('redy') is surfaced as MALFORMED and is never read as readiness. Aptness confirmed by reading the test, not by keyword match.

heading: ## The restart interlock
reason: Pins all three deterministic checks together: an injection stamp exists (1000.0), the token is exactly 'ready', and the state mtime (1001.0) is strictly newer than the stamp — then asserts the round closes so the declaration cannot re-trigger.

heading: ## The wrap-up injection
reason: Pins the contract's ordering obligation: the stamp is readable AT PASTE TIME (seen == [1000.0]), proving it is written durably BEFORE the message is pasted, so a responding declaration always post-dates it.

heading: ## The keep-going nudge
reason: Pins the ALL-required preconditions: cleanly idle, continuously idle >= 1 hour, context above threshold, no declaration of its own — nudged exactly once, with the daemon's own marker written.

heading: ## Durable stores
reason: Pins the headline store properties: a mid-write failure leaves the old content whole (atomic replace, never truncated), removes the temp file, and warns rather than crashing (fail-soft degradation).

heading: ## Daemon invocation
reason: Pins 'NO subcommands and exactly ONE option': the invocation surface carries no store/sidecar/watch-set path flags and no recovery or interval options.

heading: ## Bootstrap preconditions
reason: Pins the refusal precondition: with $CLAUDECODE unset but inside tmux, the bootstrap refuses BEFORE any tmux mutation and names the missing precondition, so no half-set-up pane is ever created.

heading: ## Attention surface
reason: Pins the membership rule in BOTH directions: every ATTENTION_STATUSES member needs attention, and the healthy statuses do not — its own docstring notes it guards the membership test so a new status cannot be added without the block picking it up.
